statement: For every natural number n, n + 0 = n.
For every natural number n, 0 + n = n.
For every natural number n, n * 1 = n.
For every natural number n, 1 * n = n.
For every natural number n, n - n = 0.
For all natural numbers a and b, a + b = b + a.
For all natural numbers a and b, a * b = b * a.
For all natural numbers a, b, c, (a + b) + c = a + (b + c).
For all natural numbers a, b, c, (a * b) * c = a * (b * c).
For every natural number n, n <= n.
For all natural numbers a and b, if a <= b and b <= a then a = b.
For all natural numbers a, b, c, if a <= b and b <= c then a <= c.
For every natural number n, n <= n + 1.
For every natural number n, n < n + 1.
For all natural numbers a and b, if a < b then a + 1 <= b.
For every natural number n, n divides n.
For every natural number n, 1 divides n.
For every natural number n, n divides 0.
If a divides b and b divides c, then a divides c for natural numbers a, b, c.
If a divides b then a divides b + b for natural numbers a and b.
Every even natural number can be written as two times another natural number.
If n is even then n + n is even for natural numbers n.
If n is odd then n + n is even for natural numbers n.
The sum of two even natural numbers is even.
The product of two even natural numbers is even.
The sum of two odd natural numbers is even.
If a and b are odd natural numbers then a * b is odd.
For every natural number n, n * (n + 1) is even.
For every natural number n, n + n = 2 * n.
For all natural numbers a and b, if a = b then a + 1 = b + 1.
For all natural numbers a and b, if a = b then a * a = b * b.
If a = b and b = c then a = c for natural numbers a, b, c.
For every proposition P, if P then P.
For propositions P and Q, if P and Q then P.
For propositions P and Q, if P and Q then Q.
For propositions P and Q, if P then P or Q.
For propositions P and Q, if Q then P or Q.
For propositions P and Q, if P and (P implies Q), then Q.
For propositions P, Q, R, if P implies Q and Q implies R then P implies R.
For every natural number n, n + 2 = 2 + n.
For all natural numbers a, b, c, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c.
For all natural numbers a, b, c, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c.
For every natural number n, 0 <= n.
For every natural number n, if n = 0 then n <= 1.
If a <= b then a + c <= b + c for natural numbers a, b, c.
For all natural numbers a and b, min a b <= a.
For all natural numbers a and b, min a b <= b.
For all natural numbers a and b, a <= max a b.
For all natural numbers a and b, b <= max a b.
For every natural number n, n + (n + 1) = 2 * n + 1.
Prove by induction that for every natural number n, n + 0 = n.
Prove by induction that for every natural number n, n * 0 = 0.
Prove by induction that for every natural number n, 0 + n = n.
Prove by induction that for every natural number n, n <= n + n.
Prove by induction that for every natural number n, 2 ^ n >= n + 1.
For all natural numbers a b c d, if a = b and b = c and c = d then a = d.
For all natural numbers a b c d, if a <= b and b <= c and c <= d then a <= d.
For all natural numbers a b c, if a = b and b = c then a + c = b + b.
For all natural numbers a b c, if a <= b and b <= c then a + a <= c + c.
For all natural numbers a b c, if a = b and b = c then a * a = c * c.
